name: structures
description: Analyze project architecture and generate documented Structures profiles for GitHub Gists.

interface.shortDescription: Turn project architecture into an interactive guide
interface.longDescription: Analyze a local project or related repositories, explain their architecture, and generate settings.json with inline documentation plus a Markdown overview. Publish the files as a GitHub Gist when requested, then load the profile in Structures.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this project and generate a documented Structures profile ready for a GitHub Gist.
